notes: §1985:VI.3.4.3 SR1 states for the DATE-COMPILED paragraph the rule §1985:VI.3.2.1.2 SR1 states for all five comment-entry paragraphs: any characters, one or more lines, and no continuation by a hyphen in the indicator area. The one converter every comment-entry paragraph passes keeps the entry open over every following line with no Area-A word and refuses a hyphen in the indicator area of one (kb/Work PB5169, COBOL7165), DATE-COMPILED included.

No 2023 clause holds the DATE-COMPILED paragraph. The wording candidates cover SPECIAL-NAMES, PICTURE, PROGRAM-ID and PAGE, not this comment-entry, so the feature is dropped.
